questions.question: Who sent the email announcing the Atlas Manufacturing deal closed, and what is their title?
questions.text:
Based on the email announcement for the Atlas Manufacturing deal closure:

**Sender:** Maya Chen  
**Title:** VP Enterprise Sales (Meridian Components Inc.)

The email was sent from Maya Chen's address (maya.chen@meridian-components.example) and confirmed that the Atlas Manufacturing enterprise agreement was fully executed as of 12 June 2026.
